headline: Civil Service Commission

meeting.summary: The Civil Service Commission approved minutes, deferred the director selection, and recessed until October 8 at 3 p.m.
meeting.recap: The vice chair led the Civil Service Commission meeting on October 7, 2026.[[0:00:35]] The commission chair was excused from this meeting.[[0:02:10]] No one testified in person or online at the start of the meeting.[[0:02:49]] The commission approved the minutes from three September meetings.[[0:04:13]] The selection of a new director of personnel services was put off because the chair was not present.[[0:05:26]] A discussion of how the director's job performance will be reviewed was also put off until a new director is chosen.[[0:07:24]] The acting director said the Department of Personnel Services finished its annual report and sent it to the department of management.[[0:08:03]] The acting director said the county does not do enough exit interviews to learn why employees leave.[[0:10:14]] The acting director said the department had more staff turnover than it usually sees.[[0:13:03]] Ocean safety officers will get the first of four arbitration award payments on the October 15th paycheck.[[0:13:19]] A union filed a formal complaint against the employer group over proposed travel language in an agreement.[[0:14:05]] The commission's secretary is leaving, and this was her last meeting.[[0:17:36]] The next regular meeting is scheduled for November 4th, 2026.[[0:19:13]]
decided: The commission approved the minutes of three September meetings as submitted.
deliberation on selecting a new director of personnel services: The selection of a new director of personnel services was deferred because the chair was absent.
performance evaluation timetable and procedure for the director of personnel services: The discussion of the director's performance evaluation timetable was deferred until a new director is selected.
The vice chair announced the meeting is recessed until October 8th at 3 p.m.
meeting.next: A deputy corporation counsel attorney has been assigned to the union complaint.
